messages:
lana: planning a conservative v2 rollout in tomorrow's 02:00 UTC change window — initial split 15% for 10m, then 30% for 20m, hold. need rollback criteria and pinlist updates.

trey: noted. main risk is clients that rely on implicit schema coercion; v2 enforces stricter JSON types. we should add a migration note and a temporary compatibility header (`x-redwood-compat: lax`) for the first 24h.

marie: agree on header. also suggest tenant-based throttling: if any tenant sees >0.8% 5xx or >2x normal error rate, auto-pin them to v1. will implement in routing layer.

ops_kai: alerting thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% sustained over 3m OR error budget burn > 7% in 10m -> auto-rollback. p95 latency > 600ms for 2 consecutive 1m windows -> suspend ramp and notify oncall.

deploybot: schedule created by lana for 2025-05-01T02:00:00Z. action: route /api -> v2 initial 15% (monitor id r-1766667777). will execute tenant-quarantine rules and send slack notices.

lana: small checklist: 1) docs PR with migration guide, 2) add `x-redwood-compat` toggle at gateway, 3) telemetry label `rollout:r-1766667777`.

trey: i've pushed a docs draft to https://go/docs/api-v2-migration-draft and added sample migration code for coercion errors. also instrumented a regression test in the preflight suite.

deploybot: toggle started at 2025-05-01T02:00:00Z -> 15% to v2. monitor r-1766667777.

ops_kai: first 6m: p50 110ms, p95 195ms, 5xx 0.02% — healthy.

marie: noticed tenant t-992 showing a burst of validation errors (type mismatch) at low volume; auto-quarantine should pin them to v1. deploybot, confirm quarantine action.

deploybot: tenant-quarantine executed: tenant t-992 pinned to v1 at 2025-05-01T02:07:12Z (event q-1766667777).

lana: thanks — add t-992 to the incident payload and CC their account team. we should also send an advisory to customers with `x-redwood-compat` instructions.

trey: mobile SDKs appear fine. server-to-server integrations reported a handful of payload rejections — most from older clients. recommend enabling `x-redwood-compat: lax` for 24h and plan a scheduled deprecation notice.

ops_kai: metrics after tenant quarantine: p95 205ms, 5xx 0.04%. still within thresholds.

lana: decision: continue to 30% in 10m if no breaches. ramp plan remains manual; no auto-ramp. rollback CLI (ops_kai verify):
```
deploybot rollback --route /api --from v2 --to v1 --monitor r-1766667777 --reason "auto-threshold"
```

ops_kai: verified. alerts wired to @eng-oncall and runbook updated. will auto-trigger rollback if configured thresholds breach. will also run the CLI manually if we see tenant-wide regressions.

marie: capturing failing payloads to s3://rollouts/r-1766667777/failed-payloads for 7d. added `rollout_id` tag to logs.

deploybot: route updated to 30% at 2025-05-01T02:18:24Z. monitor continues.

ops_kai: quick health check post-ramp: p95 230ms, 5xx 0.08% — still below rollback thresholds but watching.

lana: keep hold and wait 20m. if anything crosses thresholds, execute rollback CLI and notify customers. otherwise proceed with doc announcement and deprec notice for `x-redwood-compat` after 24h.

trey: i'll coordinate the deprecation timeline and customer comms with sales. thanks all. :thumbsup:

lana: leaving thread open for updates. will close after 24h stable or earlier if rollback executed.
